title: Robust second-order time integration of tree tensor networks
summary: We propose and analyze two second-order basis-update \& Galerkin (BUG) time integration methods for dynamical low-rank approximation on Tucker tensors and tree tensor networks. Both are built from a sequential pre-computation sweep, after which the differential equations for all basis matrices and connecting tensors are evolved by a Galerkin method. Further, the proposed methods are rank-adaptive by construction.
